notes: Group photos now know who is in them. A photo's LoRA pool used to be the shared Settings list plus the sender's own cards — so in a group chat, a picture of two characters could never load the other character's likeness LoRA, because it was not even a candidate. Now every group member's card LoRAs join the pool, gated on that member actually being in the shot: named in the scene, or picked by the photo director. The director sees the whole group's cards labeled by owner, is told that a card LoRA paints its owner — pick it whenever that person is visible, never when they are out of shot — and, in group chats, to name every visible person in the scene so the gate can see them. The route log shows the result as cast entries next to the usual keyword and always ones. Also fixed the quieter half of the same complaint: a Civitai LoRA tagged as a character or celebrity used to be given subject keywords from its tags when added, which made a likeness sit out photos of its own person; likeness models now get an empty WHEN (18+ gate kept when flagged), like the face LoRAs the app trains itself.
